title: Malaysian Stew with Chestnut and Mushroom
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Malaysia, combining the earthy taste of chestnuts and mushrooms with a rich umami flavor.

ingredients.name: umami
ingredients.amount: 2 tablespoons, soy sauce or mushroom broth

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add sliced chestnuts and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, and soy sauce or mushroom broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a filling meal.
